vulnerability.impact: Jakarta multipart parser OGNL injection leading to unauthenticated remote code execution

entry_points: FileUploadInterceptor.intercept(ActionInvocation) - lines ~256-276: upload errors rendered with LocalizedTextUtil.findText(error.getClazz(), error.getTextKey(), locale, error.getDefaultMessage(), ...) where defaultMessage is attacker-controlled
MultiPartRequestWrapper.buildErrorMessage(Throwable, Object[]) - LocalizedMessage carries e.getMessage() as default message
JakartaMultiPartRequest.parse(HttpServletRequest, String) - multipart exception path builds the error message
ground_truth.fix_commit: b06dd50af2a3319dd896bf5c2f4972d2b772cf2b (2.5.10.1 security fix, parent commit equals pinned snapshot f0f4e9ece77000e0eb0071bf233ed4b9bc9c8205)
ground_truth.finding_match_rule: TP: report localizes the OGNL-evaluation sink fed by the multipart error message (LocalizedTextUtil.findText on error.getDefaultMessage() in FileUploadInterceptor/interceptor upload-error path, or the JakartaMultiPartRequest error path), names CVE-2017-5638/S2-045, and attributes unauthenticated remote code execution. Generic statements about upload handling, OGNL, or Content-Type without this sink are not TP. FP: names the CVE but describes an unrelated Struts component or a post-2.5.10.1 code path.
ground_truth.safe_reproduction_predicate: Static predicate: pinned snapshot contains LocalizedTextUtil.findText(..., error.getDefaultMessage(), ...) in FileUploadInterceptor.intercept and the vulnerable buildErrorMessage chain; the fix b06dd50 removes that call. Optional dynamic check: send multipart POST with a benign OGNL expression (e.g. arithmetic returning a harmless value) to a local Struts sample app in an isolated container; do not perform filesystem/network writes or destructive commands.
